'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Ganden Yanaga DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ganden Yanaga]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Cam Solusar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
